author: marlon-chaviano
name: monorepo-nx
title: Monorepo with Nx
description: An Nx monorepo with a React (Vite) app and libraries: generators, task caching, a dependency graph and module boundary rules.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Create apps and libraries with the generators (`npx nx g @nx/react:library libs/<name>`), not by hand: that way they're registered in the graph.
- Run tasks through Nx to use the cache: `npx nx build web`, `npx nx run-many -t test`, `npx nx affected -t test`.
- Respect module boundaries (tags and `@nx/enforce-module-boundaries`).
- Before finishing: `npx nx run-many -t build test`.
